question: At a heating rate of 20 °C/min, what initial and burnout temperatures did the corn straw–oil sludge composite pellet fuel have?
rendered:
According to the text on page 5, at a heating rate of 20 °C/min, the corn straw–oil sludge composite pellet fuel (CF) had the following initial and burnout temperatures:

- Initial temperature (Ti): 186.9 ± 1.2 °C
- Burnout temperature (Tb): 294.9 ± 1.4 °C
